slides.title: Auditing Without Guardrails
slides.subtitle: Navigating risks when giving autonomous models terminal access.
slides.body: Direct shell access requires strict boundaries to prevent unintended system modifications or command loops.
after_items: Use read-only diagnostic flags where possible
Review generated shell commands prior to execution
Isolate test devices from primary networks
slides.deep_dive: Maintaining human oversight during agentic exploration ensures system stability while benefiting from rapid AI diagnostics.
slides.key_fact: Sandbox isolation and read-only commands protect target hardware.
slides.why_it_matters: Balances the power of autonomous agents with necessary system safety.
